Comment: SpinCollapse measured 2026-08-15 on the built-in benchmark scene under HWTSO, scene-isolated.
Seven off laps vs three K=32 laps with no overlap on any metric, and an off lap run between
two K=32 laps landed on the historical off baseline, so drift is excluded.
K=128 rather than 32, from a 16/32/64/128 sweep plus a 32/128/512 confirmation. Improvement
is monotonic in K and p99 falls the whole way, but the value that matters is CONSISTENCY:
K=32   mean 33.37  p99 72.03   mean spread 6.2%   p99 spread 44.0%
K=128  mean 33.08  p99 69.66   mean spread 0.7%   p99 spread 13.3%
K=512  mean 32.93  p99 72.87   mean spread 3.5%   p99 spread 53.8%
512 has the best median mean but throws a 108ms p99 lap; 32 throws a 102ms one. That is the
budget-exhaustion failure mode the feature was held opt-in for, and it shows up as VARIANCE,
not as a worse median -- which is exactly why a block profile cannot see it.
Scoped per-title deliberately: the feature carries a known semantic coarsening (the budget
register holds a K-granular value on the found-exit), and K is validated on this title only.
HostFeatures deliberately absent -- enableavx measured -3.1% scene fps and +26% p99 here.
